Name: More Ores
Author: hinagiku1306
Description:
[size=3][b]Key Features[/b][/size]

Configuring multipliers for ore node and forageable spawn rates in mining locations.
This mod aims to keep base game scaling factors from skill, depth, luck and difficulty intact.
What it does is applying the multipliers directly to the base chance.


[size=3][b]How ore node spawning is calculated in base game[/b]
[/size]
In Mines, Quarry Mine, and Volcano Dungeon, for every stone, each ore type has a chance to spawn in place of that stone. The chance depends on ore types and other factors as specified above.
In Skull Cavern, for every stone, there is an additional check for whether the stone can become an ore node or not. If it hits, the base chance of each ore type will now be applied to determine the node type, similarly to the Mines.


[size=3][b]Configurations[/b][/size]

[u]Stone Density[/u]
Increases the stone density in mining locations. Because ore node spawning depends on each stone, increasing it will allow for more nodes to spawn.

[u]Skull Cavern Ore Chance[/u]
This refers to the chance that a stone can become an ore node in Skull Cavern. At floor 1, there is 2% chance a stone can become an ore node. If not configured, even with 100% chance of iridium ore, we will only see roughly 2 iridium ore nodes out of 100 stones on floor 1. Increasing this multiplier will allow for more chance of ore node spawning.

[u]Others[/u]
[b]Example Tooltip[/b]: "Multiplier for radioactive ore node spawn rate.\nBase chance: 0.1-0.2% (Danger Mines), 0.2-0.3% (Danger Skull Cavern floor 1-100)"
This means that radioactive ore node has 0.1 - 0.2% chance of spawning for every stone in Danger Mines, and 0.2 - 0.3% chance of spawning for every stone in Dangerous Skull Cavern for floor 1 to floor 100 respectively.
With a multiplier of 10, radioactive ore node now has 10 - 20% chance of spawning in Danger Mines, and 20 - 30% chance of spawning in Dangerous Skull Cavern floor 1-100.


[size=3][b]Compatibility
[/b]
[/size]Stardew Valley 1.6+
GMCM
[size=3]

[/size]
